statement: EVERY PLANT, PERTURBATION OR CONTROL OBJECT THIS CONTRACT USES TO CERTIFY POWER MUST BE DEMONSTRATED TO MOVE THE STATISTIC IT IS MEANT TO MOVE, BY MEASUREMENT AT EVERY RUNG IT CERTIFIES, NOT AT ENDPOINTS ONLY.

where_each_family_moves_mass.OBJ-PLANT-SMOOTH: replaces a gamma fraction by products of primes at most Bsm(u=4), whose largest prime factor is at most Bsm(u=4) by construction, moving mass into the HIGH-Z (smooth) end of the Z-distribution
where_each_family_moves_mass.OBJ-PLANT-ROUGH: replaces a gamma fraction by q*r with q a prime above sqrt(X), so P_max = q > sqrt(N) and Z < 2, moving mass into the LOW-Z (rough) end of the Z-distribution
where_each_family_moves_mass.OBJ-CTRL-PRODUCT: a product of two integers each below p, provably and substantially smoother than a uniform integer below p**2; a single object and not a ladder
